metadata.description: Authoritative registry of all traveling poker tour sources with refresh scheduling
metadata.schedule_source: Web search aggregation (wsop.com, wpt.com, msptpoker.com, pokergo.com, barpokeropen.com, freepokernetwork.com, lipstour.com, roughriderpokertour.com, pokeratlastour.com)

WSOP.notes: Premier poker event. Check schedule page for complete event list including satellites and flights.

WPT.notes: Televised tour. WPT Prime is lower buy-in series.

stops_2026.name: WPT Five Diamond World Poker Classic

WSOPC.notes: Ring events at each stop. First-ever Texas stop in 2026!

MSPT.notes: $1,100 main events. Good value tour with consistent structures.

RGPS.notes: Grassroots tour with apparel/gear partnership. Very affordable buy-ins.

series_2026.name: Super High Roller Bowl: Mixed Games

PGT.notes: High roller tour streamed on PokerGO. Points-based leaderboard.

TRITON.notes: Ultra high stakes. Usually 2-3 stops per year in exotic locations.

VENETIAN.notes: Year-round series. Partners with MSPT for Poker Bowl.

WYNN.notes: Premium venue. Hosts WPT Championship in December.

BORGATA.notes: East coast premier destination. Multiple opens per year.

series_2026.name: MSPT Rock N Roll Poker Open

SEMINOLE.notes: Florida powerhouse. Hollywood and Tampa locations.

LODGE.notes: Doug Polk owned. Growing Texas poker hub.

COMMERCE.notes: Largest card room in US. LAPC is premiere west coast event.

BAY_101.notes: Bay Area premier room. Former WPT Shooting Star host.

ROUGHRIDER.notes: Northern plains regional tour. Very affordable.

stops_2026.name: RPT All In Bar Trophy Event
RPT Prairie Knights Summer Main Event

FPN.notes: Free-to-qualify league. Players earn seats through local bar and restaurant poker leagues.

series_2026.name: FPN Clash of Kings & Queens Championship
LIPS US Ladies TeamPoker Championship (A Flight)
LIPS US Ladies TeamPoker Championship (B Flight)

LIPS.notes: Womens poker organization. Events during WSOP season.

stops_2026.name: LIPS Women in Poker Spring Festival

CARD_PLAYER_CRUISES.notes: Card Player Poker Tour. Previously known as Card Player Cruises.

EPT.notes: REMOVED — Non-US tour. PokerStars owned. Premier European tour.

NAPT.notes: 2026 schedule not yet announced. Typically announced mid-summer. Expected fall Las Vegas stop.

PAT.notes: PokerAtlas-branded tournament series. Features low-to-mid buy-in events with large guaranteed prize pools at Texas card houses.

GCPT.notes: Premier Gulf Coast regional tour. Stops across Mississippi, Louisiana, Arkansas, and Las Vegas. Pending gaming approval.

APT.notes: REMOVED — Non-US tour. Asian circuit. Manila, Macau, Korea, Vietnam stops.

HPT.notes: DEFUNCT 2019. Was a Midwest televised circuit tour.

pokeratlas.name: PokerAtlas
pokeratlas.notes: Best source for US tournament schedules. Use for daily tournaments.

hendonmob.name: The Hendon Mob
hendonmob.notes: Best source for international events and results tracking.

pokernews.name: PokerNews
pokernews.notes: News and live reporting. Good for schedule announcements.

priority_2_tours.notes: Circuit and regional - check every 3 days
